title: Chapter 1204
text:
In the storm-like space storm, a silver prismatic spaceship with a shield cut through the waves, shuttling at high speed like a small boat in a huge wave.

Han Xiao and Kasuyi were both in the cockpit, observing the map of the secondary dimension world.

"We're going deeper and deeper …" Han Xiao looked at the constantly jumping coordinates and smacked his lips. "Are you sure we didn't go the wrong way?"

"My senses have always been in this direction. According to my experience, we're almost there." Kasuyi nodded.

The two of them set off from the Void Dimension, boarded an exploration spaceship dedicated to the secondary dimension world, and began to head toward their destination.

Because Kasuyi did not enter the target secondary dimension, he did not have an anchor coordinate. He could only transit in the various secondary dimensions he knew and try to shorten the distance as much as possible before flying across the space turbulence.

The two of them flew for many days and had long left the control range of the three Universal Civilizations. They went deeper and deeper into the secondary dimension world, passing through one strange secondary plane after another.

The secondary dimension world was like the main universe, constantly expanding and expanding. Every second, countless secondary dimension worlds were born or died. The three Universal Civilizations had only explored a portion of the more stable areas. They called the explored areas the 'shallow layer', and the unknown areas the 'deep layer'. However, this was just a difference in name. In fact, there was no fundamental difference between the deep layer and the shallow layer secondary dimensions.

It was difficult to move without coordinates here. The two of them could only rely on Kasuyi's senses, which was the only navigator. Fortunately, he had already been there twice and confirmed that this method was feasible.

At this moment, an almost imperceptible crack suddenly appeared in the space turbulence in front of them.

Kasuyi's eyes lit up. "It's there!"

Hearing this, Han Xiao immediately steered the spaceship into an arc and charged into the crack.

Boom!

Logically speaking, the cracks in the space wall encountered in the space storm would allow one to directly enter a secondary dimension. However, it was different this time. The two of them only felt the hull tremble slightly. The world outside the porthole was still the space storm, but it seemed to have changed. An endless beehive-shaped space wall appeared in front of them, giving off a mysterious blue-purple color. This was the outside of the secondary dimension world.

Outside the space wall, a large group of strange creatures wandered. They were the monsters that Kasuyi had mentioned.

"Dragon Soar.

This is the place? "

"Yes, be careful. These creatures are very aggressive, very durable, and have astonishing resistance to mental and energy attacks. Their resilience is very strong, and they can also release a kind of energy similar to dimensional lightning. Moreover, the energy of each individual can resonate, forming a huge shield that covers the spatial wall, isolating it from the outside world. If we don't kill these creatures, we won't be able to break through this shield. This is also the reason why I can't charge in," Kasuyi instructed.

Han Xiao carefully observed these creatures. They were quite large in size. Although he lacked a reference point, he estimated that they were about three hundred thousand meters long. Their structure had the characteristics of beetles. They had milky white exoskeletons all over their bodies. They were long and had distinct segments. At first glance, they looked like centipedes without legs. However, along the gap between the carapace and the abdomen, there was a circle of light blue membranous wings, which gave it the feeling of a plankton.

Every segment of the membrane wings had a bony joint that looked like a limb. At the end of the joint was a hollow bone tube that looked like a breathing organ. It kept swallowing and spitting out space turbulence. On their abdomen, there were two rows of symmetrical chelicerae that extended all the way to their tails. There were no visual organs or mouthparts on their heads, only a huge cone covered with rows of densely packed holes. If one didn't look carefully, it was almost impossible to distinguish the head from the tail.

"They look really capricious. Is it because no one can see them, so they just grow as they wish?" Han Xiao secretly criticized.

Just as the two were chatting, this group of wandering creatures discovered their spaceship and immediately launched an attack. The monsters sucked in a large amount of space turbulence, and black and purple lightning suddenly appeared, swimming around their bodies, and then suddenly shot out, attacking the spaceship.

Buzz!

Kasuyi's eyes lit up, and a huge psychic shield popped out to protect the spaceship. All the black and purple lightning bombarded it, exploding into arcs of electricity. However, he kept injecting energy into the shield, making it motionless. With the support of a huge amount of energy, Kasuyi was not afraid of consumption at all.

"Their skin is rough and their flesh is thick, and their mental resistance is amazing. My efficiency is very low … Black Star, I'll leave it to you." Kasuyi turned his head and said.

"You defend. Just watch how I deal damage."

Han Xiao nodded and opened the secondary dimensional army box. Mechanical soldiers surged out, unleashing powerful firepower. This area became the battlefield of the mechanical army.

Army Style Mechanics were best at large-scale team battles. Although Kasuyi was also good at AOE, his psychic power was more suitable for mental damage. As long as he faced a target with high mental resistance, his output efficiency would decrease.

The psionic cannons bombarded the monsters, creating charred holes on their exoskeletons. The resistance of these monsters was indeed shocking, but Han Xiao was no longer the same as before. After his Promotion, his attributes had increased exponentially, and his Mechanical Force bonus was even stronger. Under the concentrated fire of the mechanical army, the monsters were easily blasted into pieces one after another, turning into a pile of biological tissue.

At this time, more and more creatures rushed over. Their numbers seemed endless, and they fought with the mechanical army without the slightest fear.

Their energy resonated and connected with each other, building an extremely thick black and purple shield that covered every single one of them. This slowed down the speed of casualties. As more and more creatures arrived, the strength of their attacks and shields continued to increase. The more creatures there were, the higher the increase.

The battle outside was very intense, but the two of them still stayed in the spaceship and did not move.

Observing the battlefield outside the porthole, Kasuyi was a little surprised.

"Black Star, why is the lethality of your mechanical army so high?"

He had fought with these creatures before and knew their defense very well. In his opinion, although Black Star could deal with the enemy, it should not be as easy as it was now.

Kasuyi and Manison had known each other for many years, so he knew the ropes. The strength displayed by Black Star's Mech Legion was beyond his expectations. The rescue of Hella was the only time Kasuyi had personally experienced Han Xiao's strength. However, compared to that time, Black Star's improvement was too great.

"You're flattering me. You're just so-so."

Han Xiao smiled and waved his hand. He did not want to reveal his true strength.

Seeing that Han Xiao was unwilling to say, Kasuyi did not ask further. He suppressed his shock and changed the topic. He shook his head and sighed. "Mechanics are really convenient. Sitting in the spaceship, I don't have to do anything, and I can solve the problem that troubles me."

"There are specializations. Although we Mechanics have many subordinates, weapons, and money, and can adapt to almost any situation, especially an anomaly like me who can fight with Pugilists … I don't have psychic power." Han Xiao laughed.

"… I don't feel comforted at all when you say that."

The two of them chatted casually. Han Xiao opened the interface and looked at the combat information. Old Ke did not know the origin of these creatures, but he had the interface. He could see what these creatures were.

Glancing at it, the interface named these creatures' Space Lice '. Their average level was between level 240 and 260, and they were special creatures with powerful talents. Judging from their attributes and skills, the strength of a single Space Lice was slightly higher than a Calamity Grade but far from a Beyond Grade A. The main reason was their amazing resistance. They lived in space turbulence and were constantly being torn apart by space storms. The Interstellar Beasts of the past were like little brothers compared to them.

The Space Lice had an important talent of sharing energy. The more of their kind within a certain range, the greater the increase. They could share damage and transfer attributes, but there was a limit to the increase. If they reached the peak, their resistance would be so strong that they could even resist the attacks of pinnacle Beyond Grade As.

"These creatures are quite powerful. As long as there are enough of them, they'll be comparable to pinnacle Beyond Grade As. I can get a bunch of them back to breed, but I don't know what their habits are like or if they can survive in the main universe …"

Han Xiao stroked his chin and muttered.

"I don't care about that now." Kasuyi waved his hands. He only wanted to enter this secondary dimension to find the opportunity for his God's Trait Transformation.

"That's true. Let's get down to business first."

Han Xiao nodded. He was about to have his mechanical army blast open the shield of the Space Lice and open up a passage into the secondary dimension.

However, at this moment …

Boom!

A powerful energy wave suddenly erupted in the distance and rapidly approached.

Sensing this energy wave, Han Xiao and Kasuyi's expressions changed.

"This energy …" Kasuyi's expression was grave.

"It can't be wrong. This is the energy of a true pinnacle Beyond Grade A, and its level is not lower than yours or mine!" Han Xiao frowned.

In their perception range, the source of this energy was rapidly approaching, bringing with it a strong sense of threat.

The two of them moved and finally left the spaceship. They also released their auras and looked at the source of the energy wave from afar.

Not long after, a meteor shot over and stopped in front of the two of them, revealing its figure. It was about three meters tall and wore a strange armor that covered its entire body, not revealing any skin. There were only two blue light spots in the eye area of the helmet.

Han Xiao and Kasuyi sized up the newcomer, quietly looked at each other, and communicated on the mental level.

"You didn't meet this person the last two times you came?"

"No, his aura is very unfamiliar. He doesn't seem to be someone I know."

"Could he be someone who has been hiding in the secondary dimension and trained to the pinnacle Beyond Grade A level?"

"That's possible."

"Communicate with him and see what's going on."

The two of them quickly reached a consensus. Kasuyi immediately released a gentle psychic energy, indicating that he was not hostile, and sent out a mental message in an attempt to communicate with the other party.

Han Xiao did not intervene in the conversation between the two of them. After waiting for more than ten seconds, he saw that Kasuyi's expression suddenly became ugly.

He immediately asked, "What did he say?"

"No matter what I said to him, his reply was exactly the same. He asked us to leave this place, or he would kill the intruders."

"He called us intruders?" Han Xiao was surprised. "Could this secondary dimension be his territory?"

Considering the difficulty of the mission, he knew that it would not be easy from the beginning. He had originally thought that this secondary dimension was the lair of the Space Lice, but now it seemed that he had guessed wrong. Moreover, the surrounding Space Lice did not attack this mysterious person, as if they were being farmed. The truth did not seem to be that simple.

"How would I know? Looks like there's no room for discussion. Let's get ready." Kasuyi narrowed his eyes. He was determined to obtain the God's Trait Transformation opportunity and would never compromise.

"That's fine, but there's no need to fight with him. We just need to temporarily force him to retreat, and we can directly enter the secondary dimension. Let's see what's going on inside first," Han Xiao suggested.

Kasuyi nodded and did not object. He suddenly launched an attack, his psychic energy instantly surging out, shattering the surrounding space turbulence.

The mysterious person instantly counterattacked, a surging blue energy gushing out and colliding with Kasuyi's psychic energy.

Boom!

A violent energy wave suddenly exploded, and the surrounding Space Lice and mechanical troops were all swept away.

Kasuyi's mana was almost infinite, and his fighting style had always been bold. However, the other party was not stingy with his energy either. Psychic energy and energy were in a stalemate in midair, and shockwaves burst out.

The strength of this mysterious person was actually on par with Kasuyi!

Seeing this, Han Xiao did not say anything and launched a righteous two-versus-one battle. Mechanical Force shot out, dragging countless mechanical soldiers toward him.

The next moment, a slightly smaller Mechanical Deity suddenly descended and swung its blade.

The other party's combat strength had undoubtedly reached the SS Grade, and the effect of [Fearless Heart] was immediately activated!

Swoosh!

The Celestial Punishment Edge was like a hot knife cutting through butter, instantly cutting through the energy shield used by the mysterious person and sending him flying, disappearing from sight like a meteor.

Kasuyi's psychic energy missed, and he almost could not react in time.

"You … sent him flying just like that? Isn't that too fast? "

Although I was in a stalemate with him, this mysterious person's strength is almost the same as mine. You sent him flying with one slash. Isn't that a bit too much?

Kasuyi's mood was complicated. He only felt that the current Black Star seemed to be a little stronger than he expected. There was a huge difference in strength from his impression of Han Xiao.

"Alright, don't talk so much. I only sent him flying. When he comes back, we'll still have to deal with him. Let's go in and take a look first."

Han Xiao personally took action, and like a hot knife through butter, he controlled the Mechanical Deity and crushed all the Space Lice blocking the way. With one slash, he destroyed the shield formed by the energy resonance of the Space Lice, and the spatial wall of this secondary dimension was exposed in front of him.

Seeing this, Kasuyi did not have the time to worry about Han Xiao's strength and quickly followed. The two of them rushed into this secondary dimension together with a large wave of mechanical troops.

At this moment, the mysterious person finally flew back. Looking at the spatial wall that was gradually closing, the blue light spots in his eyes flickered rapidly and suddenly turned red.

"The invader has successfully broken through the second line of defense. Immediately implementing the third set of countermeasures. Changing operation mode … Change complete. Current mode — Kill!"

…

As soon as Han Xiao entered the spatial wall, his eyes were filled with blue-purple spatial turbulence. A sense of stickiness and suffocation hit him in the face, shocking him.

"This feeling seems different from when I entered other secondary dimensions …"

Before he could feel it carefully, his vision suddenly changed.

When he saw the scene in front of him, he was suddenly stunned with a look of surprise.

He was high in the sky, and an extremely prosperous galactic city appeared in front of him. There were many tall buildings, bright lights, and countless flying vehicles coming and going. There was an endless stream of pedestrians on the streets, and they were all races he did not recognize at all.

"What … is going on here?"

Kasuyi was also shocked. He also did not expect it to be like this, with so many people living inside.

Han Xiaoxin recalled that in the battle information just now, the mysterious person's name was' Supreme Guardian '. Was the target of his protection this civilization?

Looking back, the two of them were stunned again. They saw that it was not the spatial wall of the secondary dimension but the galaxy that filled the sky like the main universe.

Just as the two of them were puzzled, a sudden change occurred!

"Wu wu wu wu … Emergency shelter! Emergency shelter! "

The entire city suddenly rang with ear-piercing alarms. The ground shook, and the steel surface slid open, revealing the entrances to the shelters. Countless pedestrians and flying vehicles hurriedly flew into the shelters as if they had practiced this thousands of times.

At the same time, strangely shaped turrets stretched out from the ground and aimed at the two of them.

"Hey, we're being treated as invaders … What the hell?" Before Han Xiao finished speaking, he suddenly sensed the energy fluctuations of six Beyond Grade As erupting, and his eyes widened.

In the distance, six figures rose into the sky from all directions of the city and rushed toward the two of them.

Looking at this scene, Han Xiao and Kasuyi looked at each other with the same surprise in their eyes.

Including the peak Beyond Grade A outside, there were at least seven Beyond Grade As hiding in this secondary dimension!

What kind of place is this?

"Fortunately, these six are only ordinary Beyond Grade As, so we can still deal with … Hmm?"

Kasuyi suddenly paused halfway through his words, and his expression became extremely strange.

"What's wrong?" Han Xiao saw that his expression was not right and asked.

"My connection with the Void Dimension … seems to have been cut off?" Kasuyi's eyes widened slightly in shock.

Han Xiao frowned and secretly sensed it. He found that he was the same and could not sense the Void Dimension.

He opened the interface to see if he had suffered any abnormal status. However, the status bar was as usual and was not affected by the space interference device.

However, when he pulled down to the skill bar, he found something strange.

Not only did a large number of talents related to the Void Dimension turn gray, but even the secondary dimensional army box and Dimension Factory became frozen and could not be used.

"What's the situation here?"

Han Xiao was confused and felt that this secondary dimension had an indescribable strangeness.
